title: Insulin Pump Program Order, Authorization and Verification Terms
content:
Schedule of documentation terms for the Insulin Pump Program. Months are calendar months, days are calendar days and hours are clock hours.

| Tier | Written order validity | Prior authorization required | Prior authorization validity | Renewal lead time | Standard PA decision | Expedited PA decision | Referral documentation window | Coverage reverification |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Insulin Pump Self-Pay Program | 12 months | No | 0 (none on the tier) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 30 days | 0 (no coverage to verify) |
| Insulin Pump Commercial HMO Program | 12 months | Yes | 6 months | 30 days | 15 days | 72 hours | 30 days | 6 months |
| Insulin Pump Commercial PPO Program | 12 months | Yes | 12 months | 30 days | 15 days | 72 hours | 30 days | 12 months |
| Insulin Pump Medicare Advantage Program | 12 months | Yes | 12 months | 30 days | 7 days | 72 hours | 30 days | 12 months |
| Insulin Pump Original Medicare Program | 12 months | No | 0 (none on the tier) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 30 days | 12 months |
| Insulin Pump Medicaid Program | 12 months | Yes | 6 months | 21 days | 7 days | 72 hours | 30 days | 1 month |

## Terms used in the schedule

- **Written order validity** — validity of the prescriber's written order, in calendar months counted from the order date.
- **Prior authorization required** — whether the payer requires prior authorization before this product line ships.
- **Prior authorization validity** — validity of a payer prior authorization, in calendar months counted from the payer decision date, unless the payer's approval states an earlier valid-through date; 0 means no prior authorization on the tier.
- **Renewal lead time** — the earliest point for submitting a prior authorization renewal, in calendar days before the valid-through date of the authorization being renewed; 0 means no prior authorization on the tier.
- **Standard PA decision** — the payer's decision time for a standard prior authorization request, in calendar days counted from the request date; 0 means no prior authorization.
- **Expedited PA decision** — the payer's decision time for an expedited prior authorization request, in hours counted from submission; 0 means no prior authorization.
- **Referral documentation window** — the time allowed to complete the referral documentation (written order on file and, where required, the prior authorization decided), in calendar days counted from the program's enrolled date.
- **Coverage reverification** — how recently the coverage record must have been verified with the payer before a refill ships, in calendar months counted back from the ship date; 0 means no coverage to verify.

## Notes on the rows

- The two tiers without prior authorization are the Self-Pay and Original Medicare tiers; every prior-authorization figure on those rows is 0.
- The Medicaid tier has the shortest renewal lead time (21 days) and the strictest reverification (within 1 month of the ship date).
- The written-order validity of 12 months and the referral window of 30 days are the same on all six tiers.
